data.one_liner: Dart implementation of Solana JSON RPC API client and tools
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart and Flutter interface for interacting with the Solana JSON RPC API and subscription client. It includes support for HD key generation, transaction signing, key importing via BIP39 seed phrases, and interacting with common Solana programs like the System and Token programs.
use_when: You are building a Flutter or Dart app that needs to connect to the Solana blockchain
You need to sign and send transactions, generate keypairs, or listen to subscription updates on Solana
avoid_when: Your app interacts with blockchains other than Solana
You only need local cryptographic utilities without blockchain integration
strengths: Complete implementation of the Solana JSON RPC API and subscription client
Supports HD derivation and BIP39 seed phrases for key management
Built-in support for multiple native programs like System, Token, Memo, and Stake programs
weaknesses: Requires external test validator tools (Solana Tool Suite) for running tests locally
Focused exclusively on the Solana ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Requires installing Solana Tool Suite or using a Docker image if running local test validators.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose web3dart if you are building on Ethereum instead of Solana.
